maddeler.e:
ارتجلوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَلُوا (irtajalū) /ir.ta.d͡ʒa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# اُرْتُجِلُوا (urtujilū) /ur.tu.d͡ʒi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
# اِرْتَجِلُوا (irtajilū) /ir.ta.d͡ʒi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَجَلَ (irtajala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
